name: Hirota Asumi
source: Asumi is a pushy, selfish and quick-tempered girl. She likes to command the people and make real the crazy thoughts, that strayed randomly into her head. At least, it seems so at first glance. Actually, she's a born leader who values her subordinates, believes in the power of true friendship, and never leave dear people in trouble.
